mainEntity.name: When should my local business consider implementing GEO schema markup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any local business with a physical address or defined service area should consider implementing GEO schema markup. It becomes particularly important if your business relies on local customers, operates in competitive markets like Dallas or Phoenix, or offers services that people frequently search for using 'near me' queries. Implementing it early ensures that search engines have accurate information about your business from the start, helping you establish local authority and visibility sooner.
